definitions.gloss: regular mail; standard mail; ordinary mail
definitions.explanation: The basic postal delivery service without tracking, insurance, or special handling. The most common and least expensive way to send letters and small packages.

examples.japanese: {普通郵便|ふつうゆうびん}で{送|おく}っても{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}ですか。
examples.english: Is it okay to send it by regular mail?

examples.japanese: {普通郵便|ふつうゆうびん}だと{届|とど}くまで{二|に}、{三日|さんにち}かかる。
examples.english: With regular mail, it takes two or three days to arrive.

examples.japanese: {普通郵便|ふつうゆうびん}には{追跡|ついせき}サービスがないので、{届|とど}いたかどうか{確認|かくにん}できない。
examples.english: Regular mail doesn't have tracking service, so you can't confirm whether it arrived.

notes:
A compound of {普通|ふつう} (ordinary, regular) and {郵便|ゆうびん} (mail, postal service). The default postal service for everyday correspondence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {普通郵便|ふつうゆうびん}で{送|おく}る — to send by regular mail
- {普通郵便|ふつうゆうびん}の{料金|りょうきん} — regular mail postage
- {普通郵便|ふつうゆうびん}の{届|とど}く{日数|にっすう} — delivery days for regular mail

CHARACTERISTICS:
- No tracking number
- No compensation if lost
- Delivered to the mailbox (no signature required)
- Cheapest option
- Cannot be used to send cash

RELATED WORDS:
- {書留|かきとめ} — registered mail (tracked and insured)
- {速達|そくたつ} — express delivery (faster but more expensive)
- {定形郵便|ていけいゆうびん} — standard-size mail (fits specific size/weight limits)
- {定形外郵便|ていけいがいゆうびん} — non-standard-size mail (oversized or overweight items)
- {配達証明|はいたつしょうめい} — delivery certification

PRACTICAL NOTE:
{普通郵便|ふつうゆうびん} can be posted simply by affixing the correct postage stamp and dropping it in a mailbox (ポスト). No visit to the post office is needed for standard-size items.
